name: Ploutos Money USDC priced from the BTC/USD feed
summary: Ploutos Money is an Aave V3 fork. Its asset-listing admin called AaveOracle.setAssetSources and pointed USDC at the Chainlink BTC/USD proxy, so the oracle priced 1 USDC at about USD 68,554. In the next block the attacker flash-borrowed 8.879192 USDC from the Uniswap V2 USDC/WETH pair, supplied it as collateral worth about USD 608,700 at that price, borrowed 187.366746326704993556 WETH, and repaid the pair; a liquidation bot in the same block seized a USDT-collateralised USDC borrower's entire collateral. The admin replaced the source seven blocks later.

loss.notes: WETH: aWETH 0xd060ebd4f56be8866376a3616b6e5aef87f945d2 transferred 187.366746326704993556 WETH to the attack contract (anchor log 12; Borrow event log 13), valued at the Chainlink ETH/USD answer 208047000000 (8 decimals) that the anchor itself read from 0x5f4ec3df9cbd43714fe2740f5e3616155c5b8419 and that latestAnswer returns at block 24538896. The 8.879192 USDC collateral was flash-borrowed by the attacker and stays in the protocol against the debt; it is attacker-supplied and not netted. USDT: liquidation 0x028174a3... (same block, tx index 2, liquidator contract 0x36331e299247e5d0d3261e1d9852f6e0cffee95c) repaid 0.012458 USDC of borrower 0xcf93088ccd85a6ce1602a34d3189924489ca867e's 686.559782 USDC debt and received 1046.050765 USDT (log 43) out of the borrower's 1067.398740 aUSDT, which went to 0 (21.347975 aUSDT went to the protocol treasury as fee); the repaid 0.012458 USDC is not netted. The attacker EOA kept 181.7495471833102 ETH after a 5.6129099269201745 ETH builder payment. SlowMist reports about USD 390,000.

ageReset.description: Asset-listing admin 0xfb33205d32ca482a4d428c23181a9665d4ec02cc called setAssetSources([USDC], [0xf4030086522a5beea4988f8ca5b36dbc97bee88c]); AssetSourceUpdated (log 326) replaced the Chainlink USDC/USD proxy 0x8fffffd4afb6115b954bd326cbe7b4ba576818f6 with the BTC/USD proxy, and getAssetPrice(USDC) moved from 99993076 to 6855405329514 across this block. The anchor is the first transaction after it; the source was replaced again at block 24538903.

sources.note: Identity: AaveOracle 0x9dce7a180c34203fee8ce8ca62f244feeb67bd30 is a direct runtime: eth_getCode 0x at block 24382435, 3405 bytes keccak 0x3772ae0d8f8fb7026808eb671cec8510c67934fe274474f88cbfb7af4a84dc9c at 24382436 and 24538896; created by 0xd2c6008f440d81fcf6c35dcc017959f94a9abf2f in 0xc605e898... (tx index 128), whose receipt emits AssetSourceUpdated for WETH (ETH/USD 0x5f4ec3df...), WBTC (BTC/USD 0xf4030086...), USDC (USDC/USD 0x8fffffd4...), USDT and 0x4c9edd58... . Pool 0x7398e7e3603119d9241e45f688734436fd7b1540 shares the PoolAddressesProvider 0xda438f45470b924bc944ab156406f7868e72c5f3 whose getPriceOracle() is this oracle (anchor frame 0xfca513a8). Age: Etherscan getLogs for the oracle from block 0 lists 9 events: the constructor's 7, AssetSourceUpdated(USDC, 0xf4030086...) in 0xcfedf63b... (block 24538896, tx index 135, log 326) and AssetSourceUpdated(USDC, 0x3e7d1eab13ad0104d2750b8863b489d65364e32d) in 0xee3d7556... (block 24538903). getSourceOfAsset(USDC) is 0x8fffffd4... at 24538895 and 0xf4030086... at 24538896 and 24538897; description() of 0xf4030086... is 'BTC / USD'. The sender 0xfb33205d... is an EOA with ACLManager 0x627486b665b3c16da93881c8150e0893c5961dc6 isAssetListingAdmin true; it funded the deployer 0xd2c6008f... in 0x9d08de49... (block 23374295). The source value is necessary: at the USDC/USD price the 8.879192 USDC collateral supports at most about 0.0043 WETH of borrowing even at 100% LTV. Code age = 1772082479 - 1772082467 = 12 s.

Anchor: debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of 0xa17dc37e... (block 24538897, tx index 0, status 1) from 0x3885869b0f4526806b468a0c64a89bb860a18cee to 0x3e47945cca05439f99029a3d21e3166ce1a84fab (selector 0x095ea7b3 used as the entry point; contract created by the same EOA in 0x0186d463..., block 24456506): Uniswap V2 pair 0xb4e16d0168e52d35cacd2c6185b44281ec28c9dc swap sends 8879192 USDC (log 0) and calls back; Pool.supply (0xe8eda9df) mints aUSDC (log 5); Pool.borrow (0xa415bcad) calls oracle getAssetPrice(USDC) -> 0xf4030086... latestAnswer 6855405329514 and getAssetPrice(WETH) -> 208047000000, then aWETH sends 187.366746326704993556 WETH (log 12); 0.004289216474598283 WETH repays the pair (log 14); WETH is unwrapped and 5.6129099269201745 ETH goes to 0x4838b106fce9647bdf1e7877bf73ce8b0bad5f97, 181.7495471833102 ETH to the EOA. Earliest exercise: the misconfiguration existed only in blocks 24538896-24538902; eth_getLogs for the Pool over blocks 24538896-24538903 returns events only from the anchor and from liquidation 0x028174a3... (tx index 2, LiquidationCall log with collateral USDT, debt USDC, user 0xcf93088c...), which is merged. Not excluded as insider or privileged drain: Etherscan txlist, txlistinternal and tokentx of the attacker EOA, the admin and the deployer show no transfer between them; their only shared counterparties are spam airdrops (0xc26cdfca..., 0xb5885b4b...), Disperse 0xd152f549... and 0x5babe600b9fcd5fb7b66c0611bf4896d967b23a1, a high-volume hot wallet (nonce 1022652) that sent 0.007170014154748605 ETH to the attacker (0xf05841e6..., block 23982813) and 0.001952206032640635 ETH to the admin (0x8d7ee44b..., block 24391283), and the admin's change was an asset-source write that the unmodified Pool then consumed for third parties, including the liquidation bot. SlowMist's report that the site and socials were deleted afterwards is not onchain evidence of coordination.

limitations: Top-of-next-block execution, funding of both the attacker and the admin from the same high-volume hot wallet 0x5babe600b9fcd5fb7b66c0611bf4896d967b23a1, and the project's later disappearance (SlowMist) are consistent with insider coordination, which onchain transfers do not establish; if such a link were shown, the incident would be an INSIDER_RUG exclusion rather than a configuration-change row.
